title: Touring Europe with George Lewis, 1966
summary: The 1966 European tour, George falling sick in Frankfurt, the crowds, and England.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So, I... Did you go on any tours with, uh, with George, or, you went on tours, but did you go on any with him?

No, yeah, that's when George got sick. I went into Europe. See, I was on a tour with, uh, Billy, the D, and, uh, Nelson, and, uh, Faisal. I'm not Faisal, uh, Saeed. And George taking sick over there. We left George over there.
Was that in 60... do you remember the year of that?
Where was he, he took sick?
What were the, what were the crowds like over there? The crowds? What were the people?

Oh, the people was great. Yeah, every concert we played, man, was, I mean, packed. Everything. And, uh, George has such a big hit over there, so, I mean, they've been knowing about George, they know about me, too, because, uh, they asked me, you Chester's in the house? I said, yeah. So, he went, got a book, and showed the same book, you know, showed me, and said, you can play a book. I said, yeah.
Yeah. But, I mean... Did you play in England, or did you just play in England?
No, we played in England. We played all over. Even, uh... You did play in England? Exactly, yeah.
Can you remember what about in England did you find?
No. Very soon, so busy getting out there, man, so... I don't know.
How long were you on tour?
Was that the first time you'd been to Europe?
No, I was in Europe, and during wartime.
